channel.description: Approved local stories in broadcast order

item.description: A coastal storm may bring winter weather to the region around Thanksgiving. Forecasts vary, with some models predicting heavy snow and ice. The storm could disrupt travel and cause power outages, especially on Black Friday morning.

New York's DEC awarded over twenty-six million dollars for water quality projects in northern New York. Grants will support infrastructure upgrades like culvert replacements and salt storage facilities. These projects aim to protect water quality and improve flood resilience across the region.
The Adirondack Park board denied a howitzer firing range application in Lewis, New York. The range was planned for testing large artillery weapons. The project will not proceed in Lewis.
Vermont's unemployment rate stayed at two point six percent in October. The state ranks fourth lowest nationally. Labor force participation held steady at sixty-two point one percent.
